resources.string: Select this watchface in the Fit3 menu. Selection and removal from the app are not available yet.
IDs above 255 are experimental. Sending a file does not guarantee installation: Fit3 must confirm the result. These files support variant 1; select them afterwards in the band menu.
Connect Fit3 to get the current list.
Could not refresh the list. Pull down to try again.
Tap to select. Touch and hold to delete from Fit3.
This variant will be deleted from Fit3. The BIN file saved in the app will remain.
You cannot delete the selected watchface. Select another one first and wait for the list to refresh.
Could not delete the watchface. Refresh the list and try again.
Fit3 did not confirm deletion. Refresh the list before trying again.
Add your first watchface. It stays in the app until you select it for your Fit3.
Tap to send to Fit3. Hold to rename or delete.
Connect your Fit3 to apply a watchface. Adding files works offline.
Charge your Fit3 to at least 30% before installing.
Could not add this file. Select a valid Fit3 BIN and try again.
Delete from the app? The watchface on your Fit3 and the original BIN file will stay unchanged.
Could not save the change. Please try again.
